verdict.rationale: The edison-client library and quickstart docs show that at least literature-review tasks can be submitted and run via API (task_data with JobNames.LITERATURE, run_tasks_until_done), suggesting some UI functionality is exposed programmatically. However, there is no evidence confirming that all UI-surfaced agents (Kosmos, Precedent, Molecules, data-analysis pipelines) are fully accessible via the API, and a probe for OpenAPI/swagger specs returned 404s, indicating no comprehensive API reference to verify parity. missing for 10: explicit documentation that every agent/feature in the UI (Kosmos, Precedent, Molecules, data analysis) has an API equivalent, and a public OpenAPI/reference confirming full API-UI parity.
